purpose: Compare the performance and applicable conditions of three frozen online exploration strategies without prespecifying a winner

supersedes.reason: User chose the original full design after reviewing the scientific impact of reducing trials and duration

reset: New Gazebo process, SLAM state, map recorder and evidence capture for every trial
ordering: Within each scene, rotate strategy order by repeat and start index using the frozen runner
primary_outcome: S at the recorded terminal time, using mapping-acceptance-v1

analysis.repeat_summary: For every strategy and condition report all three trials, mean, median, standard deviation, minimum and maximum
analysis.overall_summary: Compare the six condition means; do not pool 18 repeats as 18 independent terrain conditions
analysis.pairwise_test: Exploratory exact paired sign-flip test on the six condition-mean S differences, with Holm correction across three strategy pairs
analysis.missing_data: Retain failed and not-evaluable trials, report counts and reasons, never replace or impute; omit a pairwise test if either strategy lacks a condition mean
analysis.interpretation: Report effect direction, magnitude, dispersion and scene dependence; no universal superiority or cross-world generalization claim

stopping_rule: Run the 54 declared trials once. Stop on an orchestration failure for diagnosis; resume only unstarted declared trials after a documented implementation fix. Never replace a completed poor result.
